column1: # sc/params.tsv — single source of truth for the DSP layer's Tidal parameters.
#   group   a SynthDef global effect (dirt_*), or  @module / @instrument
#   type    f = float (default) | i = integer | s = string
# tools/sc_params.py reads this file and generates BOTH sides:
#   * sc/params_gen.scd, which init.scd reads to build its GlobalDirtEffect lists
# Add a parameter in ONE place (here), run the generator, reload the SC layer.
# Without this, a param that exists in SuperCollider but not in Tidal fails the
# eval with "Variable not in scope: <name>" and never reaches the server.
